evidence_quotes: This bill would prohibit any health care facility or health care professional from instituting a Do Not Attempt Resuscitation order without the written or oral consent of at least one parent or representative of a qualified minor patient unless certain conditions apply.

Unless an Order for Pediatric Palliative and End of Life (PPEL) Care has been executed by the representative of a qualified minor...a Do Not Attempt Resuscitation (DNAR) order, whether oral or in writing, shall not be instituted for a qualified minor until both of the following occur: Consent is obtained from the representative of the qualified minor for a DNAR order.
